#545 · Megapede Pokémon

Scolipede

Bug Poison

Unova · Generation 5

Scolipede is a Bug/Poison-type Megapede Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 2.5 m tall and weighs 200.5 kg. It evolves from Whirlipede. Its highest base stat is Speed (112), with a base stat total of 485.
